title: Committed docs hardcode absolute local paths exposing the developer's username and machine layout
detail: Newly committed docs leak the local username and filesystem layout (also docs/silhouette-spec.md:10, assets/blender/README.md:41). Minor info disclosure and breaks for other cloners since cited sources live outside the repo.
recommended_fix: Replace absolute /Users/<name>/... paths in docs/silhouette-spec.md and assets/blender/README.md with repo-relative references or copy the cited artifacts into the repo.
